headline: Prio Reports 700% Profit Surge in Third Quarter Driven by Oil Prices
summary: Brazilian oil company Prio reported a net profit of US$516.6 million for the third quarter, an increase of 707% compared to the previous year, driven by higher production and Brent crude prices.
why: Prio is an independent oil and gas producer; its financial performance is directly tied to production volumes and global oil price benchmarks.

impacts.name: Prio
impacts.why: Substantial profit growth significantly enhances the company's valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The massive earnings beat, supported by favorable commodity prices, is a strong catalyst for stock price appreciation.
